Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Migrate to latest al-folio theme with personal content

- Fresh start from upstream al-folio main branch
- Migrated all personal content: 97 blog posts, pages, projects, bibliography
- Updated _config.yml with personal settings \(name, email, blog name, Scholar style\)
- Created _data/socials.yml for social media profiles
- Preserved all images from img/ and assets/
- Removed upstream sample posts and custom plugins incompatible with new theme

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git merge fresh-alfolio -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Migrate to latest al-folio theme

Fresh migration from upstream al-folio with all personal content preserved:
- All 97 blog posts migrated
- About, teaching, publications, statements pages updated
- Projects and news items preserved
- Bibliography and coauthors data migrated
- Social links configured for Mastodon, Bluesky, GitHub, ORCID
- Removed upstream sample posts to avoid broken references

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
